name: Quick Startup
author: NeverCookFirst
description: Skips the boot splash screens (Legal / IPHolders / Loading) by cutting their display times from ~9s each to 0.1s. Injects GUI\SPLASH.TXT into PATCH.DAT. Point the Game folder at RPCS3's dev_hdd0\game\BLES02105\USRDIR. Use Restore Vanilla to undo.
